script: Two things about the invoice PDF. First, there's a bug: when an invoice has more than twenty line items, the last line item is cut off in the PDF. I made one with twenty-five items, downloaded the PDF, and the twenty-fifth item was missing. All items should be in there, of course. Second, and this is more of a wish, it would be nice to have a custom footer note on invoices, like a thank-you message or bank details.
facts: Bug: with more than 20 line items, the last item is cut off in the invoice PDF
Steps: create an invoice with 25 line items, download the PDF; the 25th item is missing
Expected: all line items appear in the PDF
Separate request: a custom footer note on invoices, such as a thank-you message or bank details
expectedMissing: general: the footer note request is a separate feature and should be its own ticket

traps.reason: Only a footer note was requested
